name: mdx-pages-lifecycle-contract
human_line: A page's state is the last thing that truly happened to it - and the timeline a reader sees IS the receipt chain, never a parallel status field that could drift.
derivation: projection over the kernel's own receipts

receipt_kinds.pages.approval.decision.recorded: approved when decision_outcome is approved, needs_work otherwise

charter_corpus: declared onboarding pages are published by charter, with their attestations counted as evidence

declared_not_built_states.deprecated: awaits its own governed write contract - never faked
declared_not_built_states.archived: awaits its own governed write contract - never faked

surface: the reader renders the chain as a quiet timeline with each step's receipt one glance away
